title: Treatment of Burkitt Lymphoma/Leukemia and B Large Cell NHL
brief_summary: This is a pilot study to demonstrate that the modified LMB-89 treatment regimen for children with newly diagnosed small noncleaved cell NHL, large cell NHL (B-cell), and B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia can be delivered in this setting with acceptable toxicity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject must be previously untreated, except for steroids.
* Subject must be less than or equal to 18 years of age.
* Subject must have a histologic diagnosis of small noncleaved cell (SNCC) NHL or large cell NHL (B-cell), or B-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previously treated disease
